newContributions.head: 0e9ea44a78a815a8d616f7a0056b5db9a258331c
newContributions.title: Keep one local page across owner takeover (#158)
newContributions.disposition: Checked the admitting session, pending version, captured document identity and shutdown. Private typing is available only in the registered local rehearsal. The public read-only driver keeps its private session state out of durable storage.

newContributions.head: 1f760a41eac90734e496943937adcb42355f7eb0
newContributions.title: Show an interrupted task without repeating the action
newContributions.disposition: Owner scope protects private task history. Unknown and confirmed outcomes remain separate; switching tasks or reading a saved result makes no second file change.

newContributions.head: d8aad9fbba682f0d271cd4a5bcf3692e4be63473
newContributions.title: Show one reminder when a followed thread receives a reply
newContributions.disposition: The original must read successfully before a read receipt exists. Recheck the owner, followed thread and current provider grant on reads and draft receipts. The current or legacy Inbox receipt resolves the linked task when its binding is still valid. Saving a draft sends no email.

newContributions.head: ea6965e81551eff2277ea6cbee61c14a2b5a8887
newContributions.title: Initiative finding → Follow up → bound private task → revisitable status (#161)
newContributions.reviewedBehavior: Turn a finding into a task
newContributions.disposition: Recheck owner and source before idempotent replay. One explicit follow-up creates one bound private task; editing or revisiting cannot create a duplicate.

newContributions.head: 3079cddfd240831146f7db0c67d5b293fa19c278
newContributions.title: FastClient active budget before auth wait (managed-browser reliability)
newContributions.disposition: A synthetic slow pre-authorization step now reaches the original stale-form guard. Verified cancellation, loss of a provider acknowledgement and no second submission. Production time limits retain their own settings.

newContributions.head: 685b4d1a015be16cd32a98ef37f1ca16e6341d7c
newContributions.title: Remind me later for Conversation initiative findings
newContributions.disposition: Release a due snooze from the existing worker. A new notification gets a distinct occurrence identity; replay does not repeat it or spend another model call.

newContributions.head: abe9d9c25fdf1d5cbd194a55155bf3b3edd55e45
newContributions.title: Home initiative cue opens Conversation for Sources
newContributions.disposition: Opening a current initiative cue reveals Conversation; its sources, task and dismissal keep independent actions.

newContributions.head: 82155e24e9d634d8dc344c3f6ef6ea9fcc10b235
newContributions.title: Inbox Dismiss clears bound initiative findings
newContributions.disposition: Owner dismissal clears only members still bound to that notice. Acknowledging one member leaves its remaining batch visible.

newContributions.head: 496322d30012de94621ec815d0e44ea9d10063ca
newContributions.title: Open a cited task from proactive finding Sources
newContributions.disposition: Resolve a task citation only when its kind and prefix agree. Open the exact task and retain the underlying suggestion. Preserve selected-item intent across draft review.

newContributions.head: 17580928437f394ddf2183690a85fa208037e24f
newContributions.title: Open a cited memory from finding Sources
newContributions.disposition: Open and focus the existing saved fact. An unavailable source cannot create a fact or a follow-up.

newContributions.head: 3728c90d9fa8f34cd73928f117e0a1eda85bcd3e
newContributions.title: Open a cited local calendar from finding Sources
newContributions.disposition: Match the local series and occurrence key across time zones. Ignore Google preview references and reject late fetches after the view or permission changes.

newContributions.head: 14ce65237e036aebb9a12080d71a33f6836abfe1
newContributions.title: Focus the bound finding when Inbox opens Conversation
newContributions.disposition: Bind the receipt to its original finding or original batch. Preserve an opened disclosure across a transient refresh. A different batch cannot focus the wrong item.

newContributions.head: 6caa66f00c068aadb233882a0d3f3902f3870c1c
newContributions.title: Open Today or Tasks from Inbox morning/evening check-ins
newContributions.disposition: Morning opens Today, evening opens Tasks. Opening either preserves the receipt and performs no task operation.

newContributions.head: c4b960fecbb4e81cbc84e5945147403284d47449
newContributions.title: Keep withdrawn findings visible when Sources change
newContributions.disposition: Use a generic dated receipt for changed local evidence. Deleted wording and source links stay out of the withdrawn row, Home cue and model context. Reverified dated Gmail history remains distinct.

newContributions.head: 9275a788432dd05a2b14f5ecf67e633c4f0b0747
newContributions.title: Open Today or Tasks from the home morning/evening check-in cue
newContributions.disposition: Navigate from the existing compact cue and retain the user’s ability to acknowledge it independently.

newContributions.head: 02e84cb6e59d40ebdcb7f267e14218b69c1a2009
newContributions.title: Open the cited task from the home task follow-up cue
newContributions.disposition: Open the named task. Done, still working and snooze remain separate explicit actions.

newContributions.head: 19d6b2d49e6f3df5d90f77bfc44ed4ca5c3f6943
newContributions.title: Open the cited task from an Inbox follow-up receipt
newContributions.disposition: Use the stored task binding when available; historical unbound receipts open the list. No private task detail is returned to a paired display.

newContributions.head: cc66c38700ef4b708c627ca9e64f2f0ab15e4d69
newContributions.title: Open Memory from an Inbox memory follow-up receipt
newContributions.disposition: Individual and morning memory receipts lead to the existing Memory page. Opening a receipt does not forget or acknowledge a memory.

newContributions.head: 758462d89af7d192efb1f54b3d5c57ae64bd55f4
newContributions.title: Open Calendar from an Inbox calendar update receipt
newContributions.disposition: Calendar change receipts open Calendar on Web and the phone workspace. Independent receipt dismissal and existing calendar consent remain intact.
